languages.description: Languages of the text in the pictures (OCR).

upscale.description: Read small text on an enlarged copy (offline super-resolution).

deskew.description: Straighten tilted pictures before reading them.

denoise.description: Reduce grain on noisy scans and photos of pages.

fontsFolder.description: Also write the fonts the design uses next to the exported file.

highlightLowConfidence.description: Mark words the OCR was unsure of on the canvas.

snap.description: Snap moved layers to page edges, centres and other layers.
